name: app.hyperperps/liquidation-heatmap
title: Hyperliquid Liquidation Heatmap – Crypto Trading – by HyperPerps
description: Live Hyperliquid liquidation heatmap: liquidation clusters, stop pools, TP walls, crowd positioning.

tools.name: get_liquidation_heatmap
tools.description: Live liquidation clusters (long and short walls with prices, notional, distance from spot), stop-loss and take-profit pools, and positioning stats for a Hyperliquid perp, computed from ~100k tracked wallets and refreshed every ~15 s. Default view: walls within 5% of spot, biggest per side; range/levels widen it to the full ladder.

symbol.description: Perp ticker: BTC, ETH, SOL, HYPE

range.description: % band around spot to include, e.g. '25', or 'all'

levels.description: max walls per side, biggest first, e.g. '50', or 'all'

tools.name: get_heatmap_field_definitions
tools.description: Definitions of every field in the liquidation heatmap: conventions, cluster shape, field glossary, query options, supported markets and refresh cadence. Generated from the live API documentation.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Your tier (free / pro / platinum), Pro expiry, today's call count and limit. Needs an API key.

tools.name: api_key_challenge
tools.description: Returns a message for the wallet to sign (EIP-191 personal_sign); the signed message is exchanged for an API key.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Exchange a signed challenge for an API key (shown once; replaces the wallet's previous key).
